27153-spare-hours.title: Spare Hours
27153-spare-hours.creator: Unknown
27153-spare-hours.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. is revealed in the writings of this cheerful Edinburgh scholar, who always brings genuine human feeling, strong sense, and fine genius to the composition of his papers. Dogs he loves with an enthusiasm to be found nowhere else in canine literature.

35107-cruise-and-captures-of-the-alabama.title: Cruise And Captures Of The Alabama
35107-cruise-and-captures-of-the-alabama.creator: Unknown
35107-cruise-and-captures-of-the-alabama.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Whether or not the decline of American shipping is principally due to unwise legislation, certain it is that its downfall dates from the appearance in the mid-Atlantic of this awful scourge of the seas. Northern newspapers called the craft a pirate, and no other word seemed to the New England sea captains adequate to describe the ruthless destroyer.

arxiv-2011-09582.title: Rapid Variability of Sgr A* across the Electromagnetic Spectrum Journal: ApJS Facilities: Spitzer(IRAC), ALMA, SMA, APEX, Chandra(ACIS), VLT:Yepun(NACO), Keck:II(NIRC2) SED Animation v.1.0 ( Witzel 2021 ) , FFmpeg ( Tomar 2006 ), Jupyter Notebook ( Kluyver et al. 2016 ), Python 3 ( Van Rossum & Drak
arxiv-2011-09582.creator: G. Witzel, G. Martinez, S. P. Willner, E. E. Becklin, H. Boyce, T. Do, A. Eckart, G. G. Fazio, A. Ghez, M. A. Gurwell, D. Haggard, R. Herrero-Illana, J. L. Hora, Z. Li (李志远), J. Liu (刘俊), N. Marchili, Mark R. Morris, Howard A. Smith, M. Subroweit, J. A. Zensus
arxiv-2011-09582.description: Abstract Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*) is the variable radio, near-infrared (NIR), and X-ray source associated with accretion onto the Galactic center black hole. We have analyzed a comprehensive submillimeter (including new observations simultaneous with NIR monitoring), NIR, and 2–8 keV dataset. Submillimeter variations tend to lag those in the NIR by ∼ \sim 30 minutes.

arxiv-2104-08999.title: Beck torsors, formally unramified objects, and Kähler differentials
arxiv-2104-08999.creator: Nicholas Mertes
arxiv-2104-08999.description: Abstract Let 𝒞 \mathcal{C} be a category with pullbacks. We define a Beck torsor in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} as a morphism Z → Y Z\to Y in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} which is a torsor for a Beck module over Y Y .

arxiv-2201-09437.title: Restrictions on special generic maps into ℝ 5 {\mathbb{R}}^{5} on 6 6 -dimensional or higher dimensional closed and simply-connected manifolds
arxiv-2201-09437.creator: Naoki Kitazawa
arxiv-2201-09437.description: Abstract . The class of special generic maps is a natural class of smooth maps containing Morse functions on spheres with exactly two singular points and canonical projections of unit spheres. We find new restrictions on such maps on 6 6 -dimensional or higher dimensional closed and simply-connected manifolds into ℝ 5 {\mathbb{R}}^{5} .

arxiv-2203-11355.title: Origami in N dimensions: How feed-forward networks manufacture linear separability
arxiv-2203-11355.creator: Christian Keup c.keup@fz-juelich.de, Moritz Helias m.helias@fz-juelich.de
arxiv-2203-11355.description: Abstract Neural networks can implement arbitrary functions. But, mechanistically, what are the tools at their disposal to construct the target? For classification tasks, the network must transform the data classes into a linearly separable representation in the final hidden layer.

arxiv-2204-14171.title: Quantum Universally Composable Oblivious Linear Evaluation
arxiv-2204-14171.creator: Manuel B. Santos, Paulo Mateus, Chrysoula Vlachou
arxiv-2204-14171.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Manuel B. Santos, Paulo Mateus, Chrysoula Vlachou. Oblivious linear evaluation is a generalization of oblivious transfer, whereby two distrustful parties obliviously compute a linear function, f ⁡ ( x ) = a ​ x + b f(x)=ax+b , i.e., each one provides their inputs that remain unknown to the other, in order to compute the output f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) that only one of them receives.

arxiv-2205-14682.title: Analytical Thermodynamics
arxiv-2205-14682.creator: Paolo Podio-Guidugli, Epifanio G. Virga
arxiv-2205-14682.description: Abstract This paper proposes a theory that bridges classical analytical mechanics and nonequilibrium thermodynamics. Its intent is to derive the evolution equations of a system from a stationarity principle for a suitably augmented Lagrangian action. This aim is attained for homogeneous systems, described by a finite number of state variables depending on time only.

arxiv-2302-04858.title: Re-ViLM: Retrieval-Augmented Visual Language Model for Zero and Few-Shot Image Captioning
arxiv-2302-04858.creator: Zhuolin Yang*‡, Wei Ping*, Zihan Liu, Vijay Korthikanti, Weili Nie, De-An Huang Linxi Fan Zhiding Yu Shiyi Lan Bo Li Mohammad Shoeybi, Ming-Yu Liu ​ Yuke Zhu ​ Bryan Catanzaro† ​ Chaowei Xiao† ​ Anima Anandkumar†
arxiv-2302-04858.description: Abstract Augmenting pretrained language models (LMs) with a vision encoder (e.g., Flamingo) has obtained the state-of-the-art results in image-to-text generation. However, these models store all the knowledge within their parameters, thus often requiring enormous model parameters to model the abundant visual concepts and very rich textual descriptions. Additionally, they are inefficient in incorporating new data, requiring a computational-expensive fine-tuning process.

arxiv-2402-12216.title: Copyleft for Alleviating AIGC Copyright Dilemma: What-if Analysis, Public Perception and Implications
arxiv-2402-12216.creator: Xinwei Guo, Yujun Li, Yafeng Peng, Xuetao Wei
arxiv-2402-12216.description: Abstract As AIGC has impacted our society profoundly in the past years, ethical issues have received tremendous attention. The most urgent one is the AIGC copyright dilemma, which can immensely stifle the development of AIGC and greatly cost the entire society.

arxiv-2502-12363.title: A Pathwise Coordinate Descent Algorithm for LASSO Penalized Quantile Regression
arxiv-2502-12363.creator: Sanghee Kim, Sumanta Basu
arxiv-2502-12363.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sanghee Kim, Sumanta Basu. ℓ 1 \ell_{1} penalized quantile regression is used in many fields as an alternative to penalized least squares regressions for high-dimensional data analysis. Existing algorithms for penalized quantile regression either use linear programming, which does not scale well in high dimension, or an approximate coordinate descent (CD) which does not solve for exact coordinatewise minimum of the nonsmooth loss function.

arxiv-2508-06294.title: Secure Hybrid Key Growing via Coherence Witnessing and Bipartite Encoding
arxiv-2508-06294.creator: Pol Julià Farré ∗ , Chris Aaron Schneider & Christian Deppe
arxiv-2508-06294.description: Abstract We propose a novel Hybrid Key Growing (HKG) protocol based on quantum principles and a classical physical-layer assumption. We simultaneously exploit the quantum photon-number and photon-time-bin Degrees of Freedom (DoFs), effectively doubling the bit-per-pulse rate compared to conventional Quantum Key Growing (QKG) schemes.

arxiv-2601-14831.title: Benchmarking neutrino-nucleus quasielastic scattering model predictions against a missing energy profile obtained using a monoenergetic neutrino beam
arxiv-2601-14831.creator: J. McKean, L. Munteanu, S. Abe
arxiv-2601-14831.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by J. McKean, L. Munteanu, S. Abe. We examine three exclusive nuclear ground state shell models implemented in the NEUT neutrino event generator and benchmark them against the recent JSNS 2 measurement of missing energy using a monoenergetic neutrino source. The nature of the measurement allows a detailed investigation of nuclear ground-state modeling using a neutrino source, and gives access to a direct measurement of the neutron spectral function in a 12 C nucleus.

pmc-10572413.title: Transcriptome Analysis of Cisplatin, Cannabidiol, and Intermittent Serum Starvation Alone and in Various Combinations on Colorectal Cancer Cells
pmc-10572413.creator: Viktoriia Cherkasova, Yaroslav Ilnytskyy, Olga Kovalchuk, Igor Kovalchuk
pmc-10572413.description: Platinum-derived chemotherapy medications are often combined with other conventional therapies for treating different tumors, including colorectal cancer. However, the development of drug resistance and multiple adverse effects remain common in clinical settings. Thus, there is a necessity to find novel treatments and drug combinations that could effectively target colorectal cancer cells and lower the probability of disease relapse.

pmc-11355440.title: Oral Semaglutide in Type 2 Diabetes: Clinical–Metabolic Outcomes and Quality of Life in Real-World Practice
pmc-11355440.creator: Paola Pantanetti, Vanessa Ronconi, Marco Sguanci, Sara Morales Palomares, Stefano Mancin, Francesco Carlo Tartaglia, Giovanni Cangelosi, Fabio Petrelli, Alejandro Gugliucci
pmc-11355440.description: Background: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are a novel class of incretin mimetics for treating type 2 diabetes (T2D). This study evaluated the impact of semaglutide, the first oral GLP-1RA, on glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c), fasting plasma glucose (FPG), and body composition and anthropometric parameters.

pmc-11405866.title: Characterization of human trabecular bone across multiple length scales using a correlative approach combining X-ray tomography with LaserFIB and plasma FIB-SEM
pmc-11405866.creator: Tengteng Tang, Travis Casagrande, Pardis Mohammadpour, William Landis, Brent Lievers, Kathryn Grandfield
pmc-11405866.description: Three-dimensional correlative multimodal and multiscale imaging is an emerging method for investigating the complex hierarchical structure of biological materials such as bone. This approach synthesizes images acquired across multiple length scales, for the same region of interest, to provide a comprehensive view of the material structure of a sample.

pmc-11585234.title: Exploring and describing alcohol harm reduction interventions: a scoping review of literature from the past decade in the western world
pmc-11585234.creator: Sarah Perrin, Amandine Fillol, Sarah Moriceau, Lysiane Le Tirant, Axel Allache, Fuschia Serre, Nolwenn Stevens, Marc Auriacombe, Linda Cambon, Judith Martin-Fernandez
pmc-11585234.description: ContextRegular alcohol use is a predominant risk factor for disease, injury, and social harm. While robust evidence is advocating for implementing interventions to reduce the harms of illegal substance use, less literature is dedicated to identifying and understanding interventions aiming at reducing the various harms associated with alcohol.

pmc-12541057.title: Estimate the volume of residual frozen coal in railway carriage using a rotating LiDAR
pmc-12541057.creator: Xiang-lun Mo, Xiang-geng Wu, Wei Zhou, Yang Liu, Shu-qi Dong, Chen Zhao
pmc-12541057.description: To detect frozen coal residue in railcars during winter transportation in mid-to-high latitude regions, this paper proposes a method using a spin-type multi-line LiDAR system. The LiDAR is positioned above the railcar, with its rotation axis aligned to the train’s direction, capturing point cloud data as the train moves.
